change: Stream a borrowed String suffix through Map bit positions; advance for nondecreasing character indices, reset to original full key for arbitrary backwards positions, compare full key at leaves. Preserve public find and33-bit presence/MSB-first codepoint encoding; no Base/kernel/runtime changes.

source.patch:
--- a/bend2/selfhost/index_lookup.bend
+++ b/bend2/selfhost/index_lookup.bend
@@ -2,31 +2,61 @@
 import ./ast.bend as Ast
 
 
-# Read only the selected subtree; Map.bit preserves the borrowed key and uses
-# the same presence/MSB-first encoding for monotone and arbitrary public maps.
+# A cursor owns the selected suffix, its absolute character position and bit.
+# Keep the full key separately for leaf equality and arbitrary backward nodes.
+type FindCursor is Data:
+  FindCursor{index: Nat, suffix: String, bit: Bool}
+
 def find.leaf(-V: Data, +value: V, same: Bool) -> Maybe<&2, V>:
   match same:
     case False{}: None{}
     case True{}: Some{value}
 
-# Compute the selected child's bit before the next structurally decreasing call.
-# A leaf ignores that bit. No branch closure or reconstructed map is needed.
+# A leaf ignores its prospective bit.
 def find.position(-V: Data, map: Map<&2, V>) -> Nat:
   match map:
     case MNode{pos, _, _}: pos
     case _: 0n
 
-def find.go(-V: Data, +map: Map<&2, V>, bits: String & Bool) -> Maybe<&2, V>:
-  match map bits:
+# Seeking discards a prefix; it never rebuilds it on return.
+def find.seek(cursor: String, skip: Nat) -> String:
+  match cursor skip:
+    case SCon{_, tail} 1n+rest: find.seek(tail, rest)
+    case cursor _: cursor
+
+# Exactly Map.bit's presence bit followed by 32 MSB-first character bits.
+def find.bit(cursor: String, off: Nat) -> Bool:
+  match cursor off:
+    case SNil{} _: False{}
+    case SCon{_, _} 0n: True{}
+    case SCon{Chr{word}, _} 1n+bit: Map.bit.u(word, Nat.sub(31n, bit))
+
+def find.cursor(index: Nat, +suffix: String, off: Nat) -> FindCursor:
+  FindCursor{index, suffix, find.bit(suffix, off)}
+
+def find.next.reset(reset: Bool, +key: String, +index: Nat, suffix: String, +ci: Nat, off: Nat) -> FindCursor:
+  match reset:
+    case False{}: find.cursor(ci, find.seek(suffix, Nat.sub(ci, index)), off)
+    case True{}: find.cursor(ci, find.seek(key, ci), off)
+
+def find.next.at(co: Nat & Nat, +key: String, +index: Nat, suffix: String) -> FindCursor:
+  match co:
+    case Tuple{+ci, off}: find.next.reset(Nat.is_lt(ci, index), key, index, suffix, ci, off)
+
+def find.next(+key: String, index: Nat, suffix: String, position: Nat) -> FindCursor:
+  find.next.at(Nat.divmod(position, 33n), key, index, suffix)
+
+def find.go(-V: Data, +map: Map<&2, V>, +key: String, cursor: FindCursor) -> Maybe<&2, V>:
+  match map cursor:
     case MTip{} _: None{}
-    case MLeaf{k, v} Tuple{key, _}: find.leaf(V, v, String.eq(key, k))
-    case MNode{_, +lo, _} Tuple{+key, False{}}:
-      find.go(V, lo, Map.bit(key, find.position(V, lo)))
-    case MNode{_, _, +hi} Tuple{+key, True{}}:
-      find.go(V, hi, Map.bit(key, find.position(V, hi)))
+    case MLeaf{k, v} _: find.leaf(V, v, String.eq(key, k))
+    case MNode{_, +lo, _} FindCursor{index, suffix, False{}}:
+      find.go(V, lo, key, find.next(key, index, suffix, find.position(V, lo)))
+    case MNode{_, _, +hi} FindCursor{index, suffix, True{}}:
+      find.go(V, hi, key, find.next(key, index, suffix, find.position(V, hi)))
 
 def find(-V: Data, +map: Map<&2, V>, +key: String) -> Maybe<&2, V>:
-  find.go(V, map, Map.bit(key, find.position(V, map)))
+  find.go(V, map, key, find.next(key, 0n, key, find.position(V, map)))
 
 # Checked constructors end in a literal canonical family, under telescopes.
 # Non-declaration-shaped types retain the checker's general reduction path.

nativeLinkedStringMicro.decision: Native linked-SCon result supersedes any inference from the mixed/neutral JS probe: this unchanged cursor implementation measurably improves the prescribed long-shared-prefix native lookup workloads. It is eligible for a real native compiler-root paired trial, not a demonstrated compiler-wide or official speed victory.
nativeLinkedStringMicro.scope: Private source index_lookup optimization only. No canonical edits; no dependency on the prior 12-SELF classifier experiment. Existing 37-line original implementation and exact same U32 map/value/query workload compiled into the SAME genuine native C binary.
nativeLinkedStringMicro.previousJsGuardianFailure: Preserved type-negative NHS sampler_error is NOT waived by this separate native micro. Its exact linked-source checker semantic comparisons passed in the worker; full guarded JS acceptance remains incomplete.

nativeSources.nativeSourceContract: One unpatched C binary contains both original and candidate lookup implementations over Map<&2,U32>; IO.args supplies runtime-generated keys, query strings, variant and iteration count. Both use the same map construction, value assignments, query list and checksum algorithm. Canonical compile_book/native all-body validation, official-default clang O3, one compute thread, GPU off.
